g.title: j2195237886
g.text: Check boolean MinVelTogether

g.title: j2742082937
g.text: PapaPolar: hey M, you remember that time we took neci to the ludston museum loool

g.title: j2195237886->j2742082937
g.text: true

g.title: j3067569632
g.text: PapaPolar: hey M, you remember that time we took neci to the ludston museum?

g.title: j2195237886->j3067569632
g.text: false

g.title: j317537423
g.text: MomToxicated: Oh Lua, how could I forget?!

g.title: j2720872603
g.text: MomToxicated: I do. It was... an adventure.

g.title: j3868350540
g.text: MomToxicated: You were there trying to steal your father's Cold War tooth camera out of their storage facility.

g.title: j807030424
g.text: MomToxicated: You were there trying to steal your father's Cold War tooth camera out of their storage facility. Which never happened.

g.title: j2777399983
g.text: MomToxicated: While I had a 17 year old who was staring at all the ancient statues with the expression of "oh, maybe Paganism."

g.title: j4121215332
g.text: Probably for the best.

g.title: j942727357
g.text: What went wrong?

g.title: j1681543376
g.text: MomToxicated: While half the staff is ogling her.

g.title: j2771735016
g.text: MomToxicated: Thank you. He blames me, of course.

g.title: j3804151592
g.text: MomToxicated: I refused to cause a distraction.

g.title: j890368213
g.text: PapaPolar: c'mon don't be so melodramatic.

g.title: j569508715
g.text: PapaPolar: she refused to push over a priceless artifact.

g.title: j3109616010
g.text: PapaPolar: they were ogling you, too.

g.title: j3039259904
g.text: PapaPolar: i got pa a box of cigars instead. seemed to be just as happy.

g.title: j864244278
g.text: Hold up. Cold War?

g.title: j2565326307
g.text: Wait wait wait. Tooth camera?

g.title: j1352685458
g.text: What ancient statues?

g.title: j3690627048
g.text: MomToxicated: C'est la vie.

g.title: j3605986727
g.text: PapaPolar: yeeeah, so. my pa, Velimir Volkov I?

g.title: j374318840
g.text: MomToxicated: The gods of Ancient Kemet. Bastet, Osiris, Ra, Thoth.

g.title: j2113104451
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j109030428
g.text: PapaPolar: spied for the Rus during the cold war, which was basically when Rus and Libertatia were extremely hostile toward each other

g.title: j1455421121
g.text: MomToxicated: I could just see the gears turning in her head. "Maybe I'll join a cult."

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank6Convo1.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank6Convo1.

g.title: j2113104451->Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank6Convo1.
j3560055901
g.text: PapaPolar: but there wasn't any actual warfare. just threats, propaganda, spying, sabotage, assassinations, things like that

g.title: j3639377793
g.text: PapaPolar: should've seen the whole scaldra shit coming, now that i think about it in retrospect.

g.title: j1663519101
g.text: PapaPolar: pa defected to Libertatia, though. 'n here i am.

g.title: j853480353
g.text: PapaPolar: um. M?

g.title: j1517500351
g.text: Why were you after his tooth camera, exactly?

g.title: j2758818821
g.text: Still stuck on the whole "tooth camera" thing.

g.title: j3363767206
g.text: MomToxicated: Yes?

g.title: j1492046275
g.text: PapaPolar: pa wanted it back.

g.title: j3073677148
g.text: PapaPolar: right. so. say. you're a spy. and you're spying.

g.title: j948629185
g.text: PapaPolar: i know it's way too little and it's way too late, and i'll say it in person and i'll say it a thousand more times, but...

g.title: j2961429047
g.text: PapaPolar: figured it'd be a nice birthday gift.

g.title: j3576746030
g.text: PapaPolar: and you get caught. with a camera. bad things happen.

g.title: j3290395540
g.text: PapaPolar: i'm sorry i didn't trust you and your intel on scaldra when i should've. i knew that neci was looking to me for approval to stay or go, and...

g.title: j3044638012
g.text: ... Okay then.

g.title: j3844903311
g.text: You broke into a major museum to steal his tooth back... for a birthday gift?

g.title: j3462710051
g.text: PapaPolar: so they got reaaal sneaky about where they could put recording devices.

g.title: j672694895
g.text: PapaPolar: my pa never really approved of anything i did, no matter what it was. i didn't want to be like that for her. i wanted to let her make her own choices.

g.title: j163179884
g.text: PapaPolar: why? is that not how they do things in the future?

g.title: j3858318880
g.text: PapaPolar: and pa had this big gold tooth right front 'n center so they stuck an itty bitty camera in it

g.title: j2816743719
g.text: PapaPolar: but i should've listened. so. i'm sorry.

g.title: j2023445501
g.text: MomToxicated: We're an odd family, Velimir darling.

g.title: j728335631
g.text: PapaPolar: well, itty bitty is relative, it was still a flippin' camera in a tooth

g.title: j388277078
g.text: MomToxicated: But you're right. It was her choice to make. And I shouldn't have held her choice against you.

g.title: j3473807007
g.text: MomToxicated: Sadly, he never did get the camera out from storage.

g.title: j2076373108
g.text: MomToxicated: And your father did approve of one choice you made.

g.title: j3941987483
g.text: Probably for the best.

g.title: j286797105
g.text: What went wrong?

g.title: j875524097
g.text: PapaPolar: oh yeah? what was that?

g.title: j1138066398
g.text: MomToxicated: Thank you.

g.title: j4180092067
g.text: MomToxicated: I refused to cause a distraction.

g.title: j1811967582
g.text: MomToxicated: Marrying me.

g.title: j173793337
g.text: PapaPolar: she refused to push over a priceless artifact.

g.title: j4222796907
g.text: PapaPolar: HAH. that's true. he freaking LOVED you. any woman who can put down vodka shots like he can AND fix a truck in sub-zero weather?! SOLD.

g.title: j1452745540
g.text: PapaPolar: i got pa a box of cigars instead. seemed to be just as happy.

g.title: j3048730651
g.text: PapaPolar: sucks we never did get that camera for him out of storage. would've made a great birthday gift for him. oh well.

g.title: j3340095762
g.text: PapaPolar: worked out in the end. still got a great family vacation out of it.

g.title: j653789240
g.text: MomToxicated: Too bad we couldn't go back, just the two of us.

g.title: j2033196878
g.text: PapaPolar: i could slip Arthur a fifty and pay him to pretend to be a tour guide. we could get drunk and pretend.

g.title: j3303049225
g.text: MomToxicated: Hah! Oh, the visual there is killing me. But I'll pass.

g.title: j2232164859
g.text: You two lovebirds have fun. I'm going to go wander off. :)

g.title: j1401924700
g.text: But what if I want to pay him to be a tour guide?

g.title: j4165929355
g.text: MomToxicated: You poor thing, having to watch all this sappy nonsense go by. Go on, dear. Be free.

g.title: j2634032793
g.text: PapaPolar: (i'll float you the cash just for the laugh)
